checks.humanEvidence: Матрица содержит PromptToTask, OrchestrationReasoning, SkillSelection и ResultGap/correction, но executable lifecycle proof выполнен только для SkillSelection; остальные строки явно оставлены declared-required-but-not-yet-executed.
checks.positiveExample: SkillSelection row has covered_by_executable_probe after user-local manifest, portable export/import, approved share, continue-training and rollback/hash isolation.
checks.negativeExample: A matrix that marks PromptToTask, OrchestrationReasoning or ResultGap/correction as fully portable without an executable probe would fail this check.

checks.humanEvidence: Store manifest keeps personal checkpoint refs under the user root and outside the common repo root.
checks.positiveExample: User profile A has user-local checkpoint entries with Shareable=false.
checks.negativeExample: A user root inside common repo is rejected with PHASE08_USER_ROOT_INSIDE_COMMON_REPO.

checks.humanEvidence: Backup/export package copies the personal checkpoint and store manifest with hashes.
checks.positiveExample: Export package contains personal-adaptive-checkpoint.json and user-local-store-manifest.json.
checks.negativeExample: A missing checkpoint is rejected with PHASE08_EXPORT_CHECKPOINT_REQUIRED.

checks.humanEvidence: Fresh profile import copies the exported checkpoint and verifies the same hash without retraining.
checks.positiveExample: User profile B imports the checkpoint and keeps the exported hash.
checks.negativeExample: A package without personal checkpoint would fail PHASE08_IMPORT_CHECKPOINT_MISSING.

checks.humanEvidence: Share/copy creates only an anonymized manifest after explicit approval and disables silent sync.
checks.positiveExample: Approved share manifest contains role, file name, hash and size only.
checks.negativeExample: Unapproved share and silent-sync requests are rejected before any share manifest is accepted.

checks.humanEvidence: Continue-training loads the imported checkpoint, appends a new signal id, and does not mutate common state.
checks.positiveExample: MetricBefore=2 and MetricAfter=3 after adding phase08-signal-3.
checks.negativeExample: Missing checkpoint and attempted common mutation are rejected.

checks.humanEvidence: Common upgrade changes only the common manifest, preserves personal checkpoint hash, and rollback restores the previous common manifest.
checks.positiveExample: Personal checkpoint hash before and after common upgrade is identical.
checks.negativeExample: A common upgrade that attempts personal overwrite is rejected with PHASE08_PERSONAL_OVERWRITE_REJECTED.
